sites.rationale: GPR55 has no signal peptide in the canonical topology (extracellular span 1–23 is the native N-terminus); the FLAG tag is therefore prepended before residue M1, placing it on the extracellular face with 23 residues of buffer before TM1 (residue 24). No residue number is stated in the paper, so the junction is topology-derived from the single extracellular N-terminus. L4 and L8 confirm stable surface expression and functional internalization of this exact construct. Full-length human GPR55 expressed in HEK293 cells with FLAG (DYKDDDDA) at the N-terminus in pcDNA3.1(+); stable cell line generated by zeocin selection; receptor biotinylated at the cell surface and agonist-induced internalization monitored over 45 min.

sources.claim: The human GPR55 (nomenclature follows Alexander et al ., 2011 ) was tagged on the N-terminus with the FLAG epitope (DYKDDDDA) and inserted into a pcDNA3.1(+)vector.

The N -terminus of GPR55 was fused to a hemagglutinin signal sequence 79 , a FLAG® tag, and Folding Reporter GFP 45 (residues 3-238, contains six point mutations: F64L, S65T, Q80R, F99S, M153T, and V163A), followed by a human rhinovirus 3 C protease cleavage site that is flanked by two linkers ( N -terminal AAGSGEF and C -terminal GAGSDS).

literature_notes: All nine ledger lines converge on a single physical junction: the N-terminal prepend (insert_after_residue=0) of GPR55. Three independent papers used three different tag types (FLAG, 3×HA, FLAG+GFP) at this position in full-length, membrane-anchored constructs, with validation ranging from surface FACS to functional G-protein coupling and cryo-EM structure determination. No ledger line supports an internal extracellular loop insertion. L2 describes a C-terminal Twin-Strep/His tag, which is intracellular (residues 292–319) and is recorded in other_positions. ECL1 (83–95), ECL2 (160–178), and ECL3 (249–267) are not supported by any ledger line and are therefore not proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminus of GPR55 (residue G319, intracellular span 292–319) carries a linker–Twin-Strep-tag–linker–10×His fusion in the cryo-EM construct; this face is cytoplasmic and not suitable for a surface epitope tag.
